subject: Quick 20-min call to optimize Redwood usage — threshold trigger
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Choi <alex.choi@atlasworks.ai>
Cc: lisa.patel@atlasworks.ai, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Nov 2025 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick 20-min call to optimize Redwood usage — threshold trigger

Hi Alex (and Lisa),

Quick note — congrats on the utilization bump. Our platform flagged AtlasWorks crossing the trial threshold we track (sustained >150k tokens/day for the last 48h). That usually indicates customers are ready for a quick technical + account sync to:

- validate workload patterns (prompt lengths, streaming vs bulk)
- suggest batching/cache tweaks to reduce token spend
- review model / quantization recommendations for cost/latency tradeoffs

Would you be open to a 20-minute call this week? I put together a very short agenda and two time options below (PST):

- Tue Nov 18, 11:00–11:20 AM PST
- Wed Nov 19, 2:00–2:20 PM PST

If neither works, reply with a couple windows or use this poll: https://cal.example.com/polls/atlasworks-20min

I attached a one-page summary of things we typically cover and a suggested pre-call checklist so we can make the session super actionable.

Thanks — happy to coordinate with your engineering lead if you'd prefer a deeper session.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
SDR, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0198
redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_one-pager.pdf (PDF), recommended-rundown.md (MD)

From: Alex Choi <alex.choi@atlasworks.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: lisa.patel@atlasworks.ai
Date: Sun, 16 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick 20-min call to optimize Redwood usage — threshold trigger

Thanks Tessa — appreciate the heads-up and the clear agenda. We’ve been seeing the bump after deploying a new batch of prompts and would love a quick review. Wed Nov 19 2:00 PM PST works for me.

Can Lisa (PM) join? She’s cc’d. Also, could you include whoever from solutions engineering will be on the call — we may ask a couple kernel/latency questions.

See you Wednesday.

— Alex
Alex Choi
VP Product, AtlasWorks
alex.choi@atlasworks.ai

Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick 20-min call to optimize Redwood usage — threshold trigger

Tessa — thanks for the ping. I can join Wed 11/19 at 2:00 PM PST. Prep notes:

- I'll load the recent token heatmap and bring suggested batching rules (we can demo a 10% token reduction on similar prompt shapes).
- If Alex wants latency savings, I’ll prepare a quick kernel/quantization tradeoff slide (2 bullets).
- Recommend a 10-min/10-min split: first 10 for AtlasWorks context + metrics, second 10 for recommendations and next steps.

I’ll wait for the calendar invite — I can include a Loom if we want a short demo for follow-up.

Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick 20-min call to optimize Redwood usage — threshold trigger

Awesome — Wed 11/19 2:00–2:20 PM PST is on the books. I sent a calendar invite (should arrive from Google Calendar) and attached the two docs again: redwood_one-pager.pdf and recommended-rundown.md.

Call details: Zoom link in invite. Agenda (kept tight):
1) AtlasWorks recent usage snapshot (2–3 min)
2) 2 quick recommendations (batching + cache) + expected impact (10 min)
3) Next steps & optional deeper follow-up (5–8 min)

If you want Marcus to run a short kernel/quantization comparison, I asked him to prepare one slide.

If you need to reschedule, reply here and we’ll move it — otherwise see you Wed.

Thanks,
Tessa
SDR, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_one-pager.pdf (PDF), recommended-rundown.md (MD)
